# Aegis AI

> Enterprise AI operations platform that connects business systems via MCP and APIs so specialised AI agents can monitor, optimise, and orchestrate operations with human approval.

Aegis AI unifies incident management, cloud cost optimisation, licence utilisation, security posture, and contact centre analytics. Every AI-proposed action flows through a change control workflow with risk scoring, required approvals, rollback plans, and an immutable audit trail.

## Pages

- [Operations Dashboard](/): KPIs for incidents, security alerts, cost savings, and platform health.
- [AI Agents](/agents): Specialised agents and the findings they raise.
- [Ask Aegis](/chat): Conversational interface over connected enterprise systems.
- [Change Control Center](/approvals): Change records with risk scores, approvals, and change windows.
- [Integrations](/integrations): Connect Microsoft 365, AWS, Azure, ServiceNow, and more.
- [Agent Marketplace](/marketplace): Catalog of installable enterprise AI agents.
- [Executive Reports](/reports): PDF, CSV, and JSON exports with signed download links.

## Optional

- [Team & Roles](/users): Role-based access for Admin, Manager, Analyst, and Viewer.
- [Settings](/settings): Workspace appearance and retention configuration.
